message:
You know how kids can be a bit oblivious to the weather? I remember one time my grandkids were set on playing outside during a light drizzle, completely ignoring my warnings about possible storms. I learned that a little preparation can go a long way, especially when it comes to storm safety. I found a handy resource from the National Weather Service that lays out some great tips on what to do when storms roll in. 

It's always good to have a plan, even if the kids think they’re invincible! What’s your go-to tip for keeping the family calm during a storm?
